##### Project general facts

Azizi Venice by Azizi Developments is a large-scale waterfront master community that blends Venetian elegance with contemporary design around a crystal lagoon. A collection of mid-rise residential buildings, waterfront villas and mansions is finished with high-quality European materials, sensual design lines and refined detailing. The community offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, villas and premium retail units, with panoramic windows opening onto the lagoon and the lively boulevard.

Residents enjoy a clubhouse, high-end gyms, a spa, an infinity pool and a freshwater wave pool, together with a water park, kayaking, fountains and multi-purpose sports courts. Jogging and cycling tracks, walking paths, flower gardens, landscaped parks and children's play areas create an active outdoor lifestyle, while an opera house, a cinema, a mosque and a boulevard lined with boutiques, restaurants and cafes form the heart of community life.

Interiors are finished to a high standard using contemporary design concepts that create a luxurious yet comfortable atmosphere. Spacious layouts, large windows and balconies frame views of the lagoon, the boulevard and the landscaped surroundings. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making every residence easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a large master-planned city district in the south of Dubai, built around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. Residential neighbourhoods, logistics and business parks, schools, clinics and community retail are planned side by side, creating a self-contained setting where residents can live close to their workplaces in a calm, green environment.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city. Al Maktoum International Airport is a short drive away, Expo City Dubai and Dubai Parks and Resorts are close by, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai Marina and Palm Jebel Ali are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Dubai South offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in Dubai. Expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport and the continued growth of Expo City Dubai support strong long-term demand from professionals and families. A large lagoon community with extensive leisure facilities attracts both end users and investors, underpinning attractive rental yields and capital growth.
